title: Show HN: I simulated closing the Strait of Hormuz on real oil trade data
summary: An interactive visualization tool that simulates the economic impact of blocking the Strait of Hormuz on global oil trade networks, adapted from the Eisenberg-Noe financial network model to show how supply shocks propagate through interconnected oil markets. Originally developed as a pedagogical exercise for a Columbia supply chain class, it evolved into a full research visualization with academic paper.
problem_solved: Visualizes how disruptions at critical oil shipping chokepoints cascade through global interconnected oil markets, depleting national reserves asymmetrically.
why_valuable: Provides concrete visualization of global supply chain fragility and economic interconnectedness, helping policymakers and researchers understand geopolitical risk scenarios in energy markets.
